FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Shutter & Lens Photography Studio specializes in providing high-quality photography services, with a strong focus on portrait, event, commercial, and product photography. Our operations are centered in our dedicated studio space located in Springfield, IL, where we utilize standard studio equipment to ensure a safe and efficient working environment. We uphold a high standard of service quality and client satisfaction, managing bookings and projects systematically. To complement our core offerings, we also provide ancillary services such as makeup and hairstyling, which remain secondary to our photography focus. Our studio adheres strictly to local business, zoning, and health regulations to ensure a fully compliant operation while maintaining adequate insurance coverage for our staff and clients. We continuously monitor operations to mitigate risks, ensuring that we maintain a responsible approach to our business activities.
